A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to:
  1. Open the public hearing, receive public testimony, and close the public hearing;
  2. Discuss and consider the following alternatives:

  OPTION 1: Waive full reading and adopt on second reading by title only Ordinance No. 2022­
  604 (Attachment 1B); or

  OPTION 2: Provide direction to staff, waive full reading and introduce for first reading by title
  only Ordinance No. 2022­604 as amended by the City Council (Attachment 2).

  3. If the Council proceeds via Option 2 above, then set a public hearing for adoption of the
  amended Ordinance No. 2022­604 on October 25, 2022 and direct staff to provide notice thereof
  as required by law.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Gomez, seconded by Councilmember Alvarado, to adopt
  option 2, and declare Ordinance No. 2022­604, as amended, to include that no vehicle may
  receive more than 12 Oversized Vehicle parking permits in a calendar year, and add the
  requirement that the Oversized Vehicle must park within 100 feet from the permit’s registered
  residential address, read the first time, and set a public hearing for adoption of the amended
  Ordinance No. 2022­604 on October 25, 2022.

2.  Recommendation to:
  1. Open the public hearing, receive public testimony, close the public hearing; and
  2. Adopt Resolution No. 050­2022 which:

  a. Establishes a Schedule of Civil Penalties for Oversized Vehicle Parking Violations; and
  b. Finds that the adoption of the attached resolution is not subject to the California
  Environmental Quality Act (“CEQA”) pursuant to Sections 15060(c)(2) and 15060(c)(3) of the
  State CEQA Guidelines (California Code of regulations, Title 14, Chapter 3).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, to continue
  the Public Hearing to Tuesday, October 25, 2022.
